verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line on mcp.pipedream.com saying Conduit adds "observability" for IT teams. That suggests some first-party visibility into MCP usage, but nothing documents what is actually reported. Missing for 10: documented call-volume metrics, per-user usage breakdowns, error tracking, cost analytics, coverage of published as well as consumed servers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: Conduit adds the security and observability IT teams need.
